entries.summary: Adopted the agentic design system contract from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system. Added design-system/ machine-readable layer (meta, tokens, rules, agents, patterns, graph), agent-manifest schema and index, and the 4-file spec contract for every component. Added the AI-native component namespace (src/components/ai/) with experience metadata.
breaking: COMPONENTS_INDEX.md previously documented 6 of 46 components while the closed-world rule required rejection of anything unlisted. All 46 are now indexed; agents that relied on the short list will see a wider allowed set.

entries.summary: Initial shadcn/ui implementation of the Agentic AI UI Control System: 46 base components, governance prose, prompt library.
